{'translation': 'Over the past year, we have been waiting for an update to the new iPad mini, and it looks like it is almost here. Last week, new information leaked by Aaron Perris revealed that this device will feature an A20 Pro chip and slimmer bezels, and we already know it will come with an OLED display and waterproof design.'}

{'translation': 'While these upgrades are certainly nice, what I most hope to see in the next iPad mini is something related to software.'}

{'translation': "After watching the iPhone Duo, I was deeply impressed by Apple's multitasking capabilities. Multitasking on the iPad has always felt quite messy to me, but the iPhone Duo handles it elegantly."}

{'translation': 'On such a small screen, using full windowed mode on the iPad mini has never felt quite right. Users rarely stack many overlapping windows on the iPad mini. So I hope Apple will borrow one practical feature from the iPhone Duo: split view plus picture-in-picture.'}

{'translation': 'I really think this experience would be fantastic. On the iPad mini, there is currently no way to make the picture-in-picture window take up the full width of the screen in portrait mode, and even if it did, you would either block part of the app or have to manually resize it in windowed mode.'}

{'translation': "Bringing split-screen video and app viewing to the iPad mini's display would, to me, be a no-brainer, especially since the screen aspect ratios of the iPhone Duo and iPad mini are similar. At least for me personally, if this feature were available, I would spend significantly more time using the iPad mini in portrait mode."}
